programs.title: Reagan
programs.desc: From the glitter of Hollywood to the world stage, Ronald Reagan overcomes the odds to become the 40th President of the United States.

programs.title: Amish Affair
programs.desc: Hannah knows her secret relationship with Aaron, a charismatic Amish leader, has them both living in sin, so she decides to end it. However, when Aaron's wife suspiciously dies, she finds herself framed for murder and fighting to prove her innocence.

programs.title: It: Chapter Two
programs.desc: Defeated by members of the Losers' Club, the evil clown Pennywise returns 27 years later to terrorize the town of Derry, Maine, once again. Now adults, the childhood friends have long since gone their separate ways. But when people start disappearing, Mike Hanlon calls the others home for one final stand. Damaged by scars from the past, the united Losers must conquer their deepest fears to destroy the shape-shifting Pennywise -- now more powerful than ever.

programs.title: They Will Kill You
programs.desc: A woman answers a cryptic ad for a housekeeping job at a luxurious yet foreboding New York City high-rise. Upon arrival, she discovers residents have vanished without a trace for decades, fueling whispers of a satanic cult lurking in the shadows.

programs.title: Saturday Night
programs.desc: Tensions run high as producer Lorne Michaels and a ferocious troupe of young comedians and writers prepare for the first broadcast of "Saturday Night Live" on Oct. 11, 1975.

programs.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programs.desc: Deadpool's peaceful existence comes crashing down when the Time Variance Authority recruits him to help safeguard the multiverse. He soon unites with his would-be pal, Wolverine, to complete the mission and save his world from an existential threat.

programs.title: A Complete Unknown
programs.desc: In the early 1960s, 19-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in New York with his guitar and revolutionary talent, destined to change the course of American music. Forming his most intimate relationships during his rise to fame, he grows restless with the folk movement, making a controversial choice that reverberates worldwide.

programs.title: Chris Locke: Captain Bones
programs.desc: From Montreal, the comic delivers hilarious takes on everything from chip flavors and sausage rolls to kids' brains and vasectomies.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Lacey plans a parade for Dog River Days with all the fixings; Wanda uses a mascot to convince a corporate sponsor to support the cause; Hank battles Emma for the beauty pageant crown.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Brent accidentally locks Hank and Wanda in Corner Gas; Emma tries to get out of making Davis's special bread.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: Bash finds himself at odds with his direct supervisor while they treat a couple of skydivers with a unique relationship; Mags speaks out against her supervising doctor; a mistake comes back to bite Theo.

programs.title: This Time Each Year
programs.desc: Despite a trial separation, Lauren pretends to still be with her husband, Kevin, to placate her overbearing mother. The ruse may be just what the couple needs to finally work on their marriage.
